[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: cover scene/prefab library soft delete, unique trash entries, suffix isolation and restore safety

impact_assessment.why: library_trash backs scene/prefab/material deletion but has no direct project coverage; only material restore is exercised through GameSession.
impact_assessment.benefits: Tests pin delete/trash/restore round trips, dotted names, unique trash filenames, suffix isolation, path/suffix/collision refusals and intact content after a rejected restore.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: temp library directories only; no game/sim/hash change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Temp directories per test, real SceneLibrary/PrefabLibrary APIs, full suite, determinism and project gates.
